vulnerabilities.name: Missing Strict-Transport-Security Header
vulnerabilities.description: The Strict-Transport-Security header is missing, which may lead to security issues.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header with a suitable max-age directive.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
vulnerabilities.description: The Content-Security-Policy header is missing, which may lead to security issues.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement a Content Security Policy to prevent XSS attacks.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
vulnerabilities.description: The X-Content-Type-Options header is missing, which may lead to security issues.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add the X-Content-Type-Options header with the nosniff directive.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
vulnerabilities.description: The X-Frame-Options header is missing, which may lead to security issues.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add the X-Frame-Options header with DENY or SAMEORIGIN value.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing X-XSS-Protection Header
vulnerabilities.description: The X-XSS-Protection header is missing, which may lead to security issues.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add the X-XSS-Protection header with mode=block directive.
